meta.name: azure-hosted-copilot-sdk
meta.description: Build, deploy, and modify GitHub Copilot SDK apps on Azure. MANDATORY when codebase contains @github/copilot-sdk or CopilotClient in package.json. PREFER OVER azure-prepare when copilot-sdk markers detected. WHEN: copilot SDK, @github/copilot-sdk, copilot-powered app, build copilot app, prepare copilot app, add feature to copilot app, modify copilot app, BYOM, bring your own model, CopilotClient, createSession, sendAndWait, azd init copilot. DO NOT USE FOR: deploying already-prepared copilot-sdk apps (use azure-deploy), general web apps without copilot SDK (use azure-prepare), Copilot Extensions, Foundry agents (use microsoft-foundry).

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude帮你把GitHub Copilot SDK应用构建、修改并部署到Azure上。它会自动检测代码中是否使用了Copilot SDK，然后执行相应的脚手架搭建、模型配置和部署步骤。
howto.when: 当你的项目代码中包含@github/copilot-sdk或CopilotClient等SDK标记时，或者你要求构建、修改、添加功能到Copilot SDK应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我用Copilot SDK新建一个项目并部署到Azure。
say.note: Claude会执行脚手架搭建和部署流程。

say.text: 给现有的Copilot SDK应用添加一个新功能。
配置我的Copilot SDK应用使用Azure自带的模型。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you build, modify, and deploy GitHub Copilot SDK apps on Azure. It detects Copilot SDK markers in your codebase, then scaffolds, configures models, and deploys accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your project contains @github/copilot-sdk or CopilotClient markers, or when you ask to build, modify, or add features to a Copilot SDK app.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new Copilot SDK project and deploy it to Azure.
say_en.note: Claude will run scaffolding and deployment.

say_en.text: Add a new feature to my existing Copilot SDK app.
say_en.note: Claude will implement using SDK patterns.

say_en.text: Configure my Copilot SDK app to use an Azure-hosted model.
say_en.note: Claude will set up BYOM auth and model config.
